remarks: Stunning Tri Level Duplex Home. Completely Renovated, Featuring New Windows and Flooring, Gorgeous New Kitchen with White Cabinets, Quartz Counters and Stainless Appliances, Leads out to Deck and Fenced in Backyard. Bright and Spacious Living Room with Recessed Lighting Flows Seamlessly into the Dining Area. On the Main Level, You'll also Find Convenient Laundry, Guest Half Bath, Large Closet and a Pantry for Extra Storage. Upper Level Has Two Generously Sized Bedrooms and a Sparkling New Bathroom. The Lower Level includes a Large Family Room, Plus a Separate Unfinished Storage Area that Could Easily Serve as a Workout Space or Additional Storage. Terrific Location Ideally Situated at the End of a Cul-de-sac and Just a Stone's Throw from Chelsea Piers and Local Beaches, Parks, I-95, and Shopping. Excellent Credit and References a Must. Tenant Responsible for Two Months Security Deposit, Credit Report, Liability Insurance and Electric. No Maintenance or Amenity Charges, Move Right In.
